trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: Tomorrow at nine the crew will working.
trap.right: Tomorrow at nine the crew will be working.
trap.why: Faltando o be, o brasileiro cria “will working”. Revise: will be + -ing (em curso) e will have + particípio (concluído).

mcq.q: At nine, the crew **___** loading the truck.
By nine, the crew **___** loaded the truck.
Esther **___** be home; the lights are off.

fix.wrong: By nine the crew will be load it.
fix.right: By nine the crew will have loaded it.

fix.wrong: Dan mustn’t have called; the phone is silent.
fix.right: Dan can’t have called; the phone is silent.

fix.wrong: Ella will have wait for an hour.
fix.right: Ella will have waited for an hour.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “At nine the crew loads the truck.” (will be)
rewrite.answer: At nine the crew will be loading the truck.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “The crew loads the truck by nine.” (will have)
rewrite.answer: The crew will have loaded the truck by nine.
